select year(DIFFERENTIATION_DATE), max(SIZE_OF_COLONY)
from ECOLI_DATA
group by year(DIFFERENTIATION_DATE)

select year(differentiation_date) as year, f1.max_size - ed.size_of_colony as year_dev, ed.id
from ecoli_data ed
join (select year(DIFFERENTIATION_DATE) as year, max(SIZE_OF_COLONY) as max_size
from ECOLI_DATA
group by year(DIFFERENTIATION_DATE)) as f1 on year(ed.differentiation_date) = f1.year
order by year asc, year_dev asc

SELECT YEAR(differentiation_date) AS year, f1.max_size - ed.size_of_colony AS year_dev, ed.id
FROM ecoli_data ed
JOIN (
    SELECT year(DIFFERENTIATION_DATE) AS year, MAX(SIZE_OF_COLONY) AS max_size
    FROM ECOLI_DATA
    GROUP BY year(DIFFERENTIATION_DATE)
    ) AS f1 
    ON YEAR(ed.differentiation_date) = f1.year
ORDER BY year ASC, year_dev ASC
